answer: Each agent identity requires a bond of 500 tokens plus a hardware credential recorded once per device, forming the anchor of registration. Registering a fake identity thereby locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs, and provable duplicate claims get 100 percent slashed. Splitting identities fails because each fake copy re-locks a full bond, a shared penalty hits every mirror of a device, and an independent jury detects the ridge between credential reuse.
